name: Karl Landsteiner
contribution: An Austrian-American biologist, physician, and immunologist.

checks.lead: Karl Landsteiner  (German: [kaʁl ˈlantˌʃtaɪnɐ]; 14 June 1868 – 26 June 1943) was an Austrian-American biologist, physician, and immunologist. He emigrated with his family to New York in 1923 at the age of 55 for professional opportunities, working for the Rockefeller Institute.
